rate_table_note: Rates are Exhibit 21 (Credit Life Insurance Presumptive Premium Rates), saved as TX-3.5206-Exhibit-21.html, for Class E alone (dealers, including auto and truck, other dealers and retail stores) and for all classes except Class E. Single premium rates for plans 1, 2, 5 and 6 must be multiplied by the discount factor 1/(1 + (i x n)/24), i = .035, n = term in months (not applied here). TDI's yearly lists of proposed and adopted rules for 2006 to 2026 show no later amendment of 3.5206 (credit items in 2009, 2012, 2013 and 2021 concern reserves, company obligations, the consumer bill of rights and the experience call); the official Texas Administrative Code (Secretary of State) could not be read by the tool. Also saved: archive/TX/2026-11-21_d5ff8267.html (TX-3.5206-Exhibit-21.html).

summary: Rates in force: Texas presumptive premium rates for credit life in 28 TAC 3.5206 (Exhibit 21), adopted May 18, 2005 and used on or after January 1, 2006, with separate rates for Class E (dealers) and all other classes: for example $0.322 per year per $100 single premium reducing and $0.514 per month per $1000 outstanding balance, single life, for classes other than E.
